MARKET OUTPERFORMANCE AND THE VALUE ENGINE | G2-G6
+-- Management's Q3 2026 comparison
|   +-- [S] Three-year US merchant online CAGR 23%; market 8%.
|   +-- [S] Europe merchant online GMV CAGR 37%; market 8%.
|   `-- [S] Q3 GMV growth evenly split: new and same-store sales.
+-- Interpretation
|   +-- [I] Platform totals include new merchants and migrations.
|   +-- [I] Aggregate share gains do not establish incumbent uplift.
|   `-- [I] No same-store three-year series or matched control supplied.
+-- Conditional arithmetic, not an observed outcome
|   +-- [I] Halving 23% growth gives 11.5%; minus 8% = 3.5 points.
|   +-- [I] Halving Q3's 30% gives 15%; minus 8% = 7 points.
|   `-- [I] Mixes periods, regions and channels; seed's 3.5-7 is unvalidated.
+-- Revenue translation
|   +-- [S] Q3 2026 Merchant Solutions +35%: GMV and payments adoption.
|   +-- [S] Subscription Solutions +20%: Standard, Plus, variable fees.
|   +-- [S] Variable fees grow from more merchants above minimums
|   |       and higher sales from those already above them.
|   `-- merchant success -[assoc]-> Shopify results
+-- Reported structure boundary
    [I] Plan tiers, merchant-size bands and channels are analytical views.
    [I] These excerpts do not establish them as reportable segments.
